newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan chip shares unmoved by Samsung output cut.
newsitem.headline: Japan chip shares unmoved by Samsung output cut.

text.p: Shares of Japanese chip makers were unmoved by news that Samsung Electronics Co Ltd would further cut production of 16-megabit dynamic random access memory chips (DRAMs), brokers said on Thursday.
The shares fell prey to profit-taking following a rally on Wednesday.
"If the reports of production cuts are true, it will be a plus for the chip market, which is suffering from an oversupply.
"However, it is still too early to say how much the market will improve and we are not in a hurry to revise our outlook," a Hitachi spokesman said.
As of 0406 GMT, shares of Fujitsu Ltd were down 20 yen at 1,220 yen. NEC Corp was unchanged at 1,430 yen after earlier falling to 1,410 yen.
Hitachi Ltd was also flat at 1,060 yen although it had shed 10 yen earlier in the afternoon.
Samsung said that it was scaling down its production due to worsening profitability because of low prices.
